paper.backtest_2y: about break-even over ~2.7 years (profit factor ~1.0, max drawdown ~$330-530): no proven edge

daily_bots_note: Bot B (daily 20-day breakout, 3xATR stop) and Bot C (daily EMA20/100 trend, 3xATR stop) each start with $1000 fake money, $10 risk/trade, swap counted. Research: profitable on 2010-2019 (train) AND 2020-2026 (unseen test), but only ~3 trades per year and helped by the strong 2021-2024 USD/JPY uptrend. fx/research2.json tested the same rules on 11 pairs since 2010: they lost on 9 of 11 (profit factor 0.78), so Bot C's USD/JPY edge is probably luck; Bot C+ (11 pairs) was turned off.
real_money_checklist: ALL of: >=6 months of paper trading, >=30 closed trades, profit factor > 1.3, max drawdown < $100 (10%, measured on closed trades; open trades can add more). Even then: tiny size only. Not financial advice.
